scenario_definition.name: aggregate_spill
scenario_definition.title: Grouped aggregate under work_mem pressure
scenario_definition.description: Runs a real grouped aggregate with a session-scoped low work_mem; the baseline can spill sort/aggregate state, while the after phase checks the actual in-memory PostgreSQL plan after a typed action.
scenario_definition.query: SELECT sum(order_count)::bigint AS total_rows FROM (SELECT customer_id, count(*)::bigint AS order_count FROM keeninsight_demo.orders GROUP BY customer_id) g

run_a.query: SELECT sum(order_count)::bigint AS total_rows FROM (SELECT customer_id, count(*)::bigint AS order_count FROM keeninsight_demo.orders GROUP BY customer_id) g

database_measurement.note: Rates include the measured workload plus any concurrent database activity and observer transactions.

query_measurement.query: SELECT sum(order_count)::bigint AS total_rows FROM (SELECT customer_id, count(*)::bigint AS order_count FROM keeninsight_demo.orders GROUP BY customer_id) g

before.query: SELECT sum(order_count)::bigint AS total_rows FROM (SELECT customer_id, count(*)::bigint AS order_count FROM keeninsight_demo.orders GROUP BY customer_id) g

after.query: SELECT sum(order_count)::bigint AS total_rows FROM (SELECT customer_id, count(*)::bigint AS order_count FROM keeninsight_demo.orders GROUP BY customer_id) g

query_measurement.note: The before snapshot is taken after warmups; the delta covers timed calls, plus any concurrent execution of the same statement template.

run_a.measurement_note: Warm-up executions are excluded from timed samples. Baseline uses a session-only work_mem value; after-phase uses the actual new session default after the typed database action. PostgreSQL plan nodes and temporary-block counters are inspected for operator-specific spill evidence. Client timing includes the PostgreSQL round trip; no expected value is substituted.

action_proposal.description: Set database-level work_mem to 8MB for new sessions; validate the spilling query again before keeping it.
action_proposal.source: observed EXPLAIN spill/memory fields and pg_settings.work_mem
